_comment: Merge into the new project's package.json. All remotion / @remotion/* packages MUST share one exact version: replace 4.0.529 with the `remotion` version that create-video installed (or run `npx remotion upgrade` afterwards). Equivalent: npx remotion add @remotion/media @remotion/fonts @remotion/google-fonts && npm i katex && npm i -D @types/katex
optionalDependencies_comment: Useful but not required by the template: @remotion/paths, @remotion/shapes, @remotion/noise, @remotion/transitions (same exact version).
